_doc: Copy of the defaults. Every key is optional; delete what you do not change. Keys starting with _ are comments.
title: Claude Code
_phone: false keeps notifications off your phone: ntfy and Pushover are skipped. 'notify.py --phone off' sets this and also turns off Claude Code's own phone pushes.
_sound: Any name in /System/Library/Sounds, or "" for a silent banner.
_wait_minutes: How long a turn may wait on background work before the watcher posts 'still waiting on ...'.
_include_last_message: true appends the start of Claude's last message to the body, handy on a phone.

ntfy._doc: Install the ntfy app, subscribe to a hard-to-guess topic, put it here. Free, no account.

webhook._doc: POSTs JSON {title, subtitle, message, event, text}. Slack incoming webhooks accept it as is.

channels._command: A command of your own, run as: command... TITLE SUBTITLE MESSAGE. Example: ["say"] reads every notification aloud.
